dialogues.speaker: Jutta
dialogues.text: It's an opportunity... It's such a great opportunity...

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Are you talking to me? Well, as you can see, I'm just a lowly merchant from Mondstadt that can't get in on the action.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: I was originally here on vacation. But when I heard about the competition, I couldn't help but come and take a look. And, wow, did I discover an amazing opportunity! Unfortunately, I couldn't convince the organizers, and my proposal was declined. *sigh* This really sucks...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you got your merchant side awakened...

choices.text: *sob* Money never made is money lost...

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: I'm not upset, I just think it's a shame.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: I really don't feel like they've tapped into the commercial potential of this competition. They didn't even put up any booths around the main venue.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: There's not even a rest area by the Domain where most of the contestants are. They could've at least put a small snack stand here!

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: If it were up to me, I would arrange for limited-edition competition souvenirs, toys, and coloring books starting from the very first round.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: The more food and beverage stands we could fit, the better. Not only would we have to provide a day's worth of meals to the competitors, we'd also need to serve as many members of the audience as possible.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Oh, and it seems like they installed a lot of Film Kameras around the arena. I think they're making some kind of "documentary film." We could sell that for a good price as well.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: I'm sure the devices to play the film wouldn't be cheap either!

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Anyways, there are great opportunities for monetization in every facet of this competition.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really does sound like there are a lot of ways to make money here. However, the organizers and their sponsor don't seem to be short on Mora. Maybe they don't care about whether the competition makes money or not.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Well, that's the problem! Even if they're doing this for some... noble cause... They can use the funds they've earned and invest them into future competitions to create a healthy cycle!

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: I don't think that the sponsor behind this competition has any business sense. They seem to be... a rookie.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: They seem like the type who suddenly came into a bunch of Mora, then splurge mindlessly. What are they thinking?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, what an unforgiving merchant! You have no mercy for your peers...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe it's because you think about things more thoroughly.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Ha, that's something I wouldn't mind hearing twice. Thank you!

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: However, compliments don't miraculously turn into Mora.

choices.text: Don't worry about it. There's always next time.

response.speaker: Jutta
response.text: Well then, if you ever want to talk business, I'm always free.
